sections.content: How many people stayed in Brandon (Forest Heath) after gaining qualifications?

Brandon (Forest Heath) is a small town in the East of England. Brandon (Forest Heath) does not have its own university.

Brandon (Forest Heath) has medium levels of deprivation.

Overall, Brandon (Forest Heath) ended up with:

  • a similar number of non-graduates with advanced qualifications as it produced
Note: all towns and cities in this analysis are defined based on population size only. This means that some cities are classed as towns because of their population.

Let's explore this further

There were 320 state-school pupils from Brandon (Forest Heath) who sat their GCSEs between the 2007 to 2008 and the 2010 to 2011 school years.

Of these, 50 (16%) went on to gain degree-level qualifications (level 6+ as defined by The Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, or Ofqual ). We will call these people graduates.

Another 90 (28%) went on to gain other advanced post-16 qualifications, such as A-Levels, a foundation degree or higher apprenticeship (levels 3-5 as defined by Ofqual). In this tool, we will refer to these non-graduates with advanced qualifications as “qualified non-graduates", for brevity.

The charts below compare Brandon (Forest Heath) to other English towns and cities using three measures:

  • what proportion of Brandon (Forest Heath)'s pupils became graduates or qualified non-graduates by the 2017 to 2018 academic year
  • of those graduates and qualified non-graduates, the percentages that lived in Brandon (Forest Heath) in the 2018 to 2019 academic year
  • how many graduates and qualified non-graduates from elsewhere came to live there by 2018 to 2019, relative to the number who sat their GCSEs there

In some towns, some of this information may not be available because of small sample sizes.
The size and deprivation level of a town, as well as the qualification levels of older residents, were all related to students' educational attainment. Read our previous analysis.

In 2018 to 2019, 44% of qualified non-graduates living in Brandon (Forest Heath) had moved there from elsewhere

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, there were 90 qualified (level 3+) non-graduates from our cohort living in Brandon (Forest Heath), compared with the 90 qualified non-graduates who had lived there when they sat their GCSEs.

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, 56% of qualified (level 3+) non-graduates in Brandon (Forest Heath) had also lived there when they sat their GCSEs, while 44% had moved there from elsewhere.
